audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0-3 showed Skill or Yone while every why on the same page says Wukong owns levels 1-5.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is [Wukong x4, Skill, Yone, Yone] and the mirror set rows 0-3 to Wukong; whys[0] through whys[3] already read that way.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 2 and 3 -> Wukong at 3/10, as matched full+content pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 3 and 4-5 phases claimed your pattern comes online and you take lane control, contradicting the rows and the whys.
audit.why: His repeatable dash-in and armour shred are what decide 3-5; your spike is first item.
audit.corrected: phases[2].why and phases[3].why rewritten to name his mechanic and point the reader at the first-item spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page swapped two of Wukong's abilities: spikes[0].text calls the decoy 'Nimbus Strike (W is his decoy, W-tick is the E clone-dash)' and mid calls it 'Nimbus Strike (W-decoy plus dash)'. Crushing Blow's auto-reset was never given as the tell.
audit.why: Warrior Trickster is the W (decoy); Nimbus Strike is the E (dash). Crushing Blow opens his combo with an auto-attack reset, so the wind-up is the cue, not the cast.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text, mid, breakdown.cooldowns and dontsFull[1].d rewritten with the correct slots and the reset tell.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Wukong must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Nimbus Strike (E) gives him a repeatable dash-in at 3 and Crushing Blow shreds your armour. Farm at range, trade after.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Nimbus Strike's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: His cooldowns are up more often than yours at 4-5 and his all-in still beats yours. Farm safe and hold for your first item.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Crushing Blow resets his auto — step off as he winds up, not after.

edits.before: - Wukong Nimbus Strike: matchup-defining — His engage dash. Q3-R after it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Nimbus Strike (E): his dash-in — Q3-R once it is spent. - Warrior Trickster (W): the decoy, so check which body is taking damage. - Soul Unbound (E): 22s at rank 1 — never spend it on chip.

edits.before: Wukong's spike: with Crushing Blow (Q) armor shred plus Nimbus Strike (W is his decoy, W-tick is the E clone-dash) he trades on cooldown and shoves you off the wave. Respect his all-in windows and don't burn E into his stun setup.
edits.after: Crushing Blow (Q) shreds your armour and Warrior Trickster (W) leaves a decoy while he steps away — the clone is what your combo lands on. Nimbus Strike (E) is the dash-in, so hold your own E until his is spent.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 stay Wukong-favoured: his Nimbus Strike (W-decoy plus dash) and Crushing Blow give him strong repeatable all-ins, and level 6 Cyclone is a hard threat to your dashes. Don't E in blind, and keep W ready to negate his engage. Farm safely and wait for items.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 stay Wukong-favoured: Nimbus Strike (E) dashes him in, Warrior Trickster (W) leaves a decoy to eat your combo, and Crushing Blow shreds you. Level 6 Cyclone threatens your dashes — don't E in blind, keep W for his engage, and farm to items.

notes: enemyKit was null in this brief, so no Wukong cooldown numbers were written anywhere — the ability slots come from packet.enemyAbilities, which is name-authoritative but carries no timers. If a Wukong kit file becomes available, this matchup is worth a second pass to put real numbers on Crushing Blow, Warrior Trickster and Cyclone.
